author: Woprrr

title: Magical help
body:
Hello, everyone.

As a person with ADHD, I have struggled with both sleep and concentration for many years. For the past 12 years, I have fallen asleep while listening to podcasts. Even though I am a musician and a music lover myself, I have never been able to listen to music either to fall asleep or while working.

Brain.fm has provided exactly the kind of music that, almost magically, helps me fall asleep within seconds and allows me to concentrate on my work without constantly needing to distract myself with side activities for hours.

Of course, everyone is different, and what works for one person may not work for another. However, in my case, Brain.fm has made a tremendous difference, and I am very grateful for it. I hope to remain a loyal user for many years to come.

I would also like to mention that I shared this experience with my psychiatrist, who was initially very skeptical. I plan to provide him with research and other evidence showing that neurologically designed music can indeed be beneficial. Hopefully, it will encourage him to look more closely at the scientific literature on the subject.

title: Disappointing Support Experience for Refunds
body:
I really wanted to like Brain.fm — the app itself is fine. But unfortunately, my experience with their support has left a bad impression.

I forgot to cancel my annual subscription and reached out for a refund well within their 60-day money-back guarantee. What followed was a frustrating chain of back-and-forth emails just to process a simple, standard request. I had to explain my situation multiple times and was even asked to confirm the last four digits of my card, despite having only ever used one.

This kind of overcomplicated and time-wasting process is disappointing — especially for something that should take a single email to resolve. Support should make things easier, not drag them out with unnecessary steps.

I hope Brain.fm simplifies its customer service experience in the future. Until then, I can’t recommend it in good faith.

title: Musique 4, app 1.5
body:
Je trouve les musiques très bonnes pour la concentration, c’est l’app qui est vraiment à revoir. 

Mes griefs principaux :
- la navigation n’est pas intuitive
- le mode offline nécessite plusieurs sélections et le bouton back renvoie presque toujours au menu Home
- grosse consommation de batterie (même en offline)
- buffer pour le streaming trop petit (s’interrompt régulièrement si réseau moyen)

title: Application à revoir
body:
Le principe est pas mal. Certains musiques ne sont guère d’autres que du bruit mais le reste est très agréable et apaisant.

Par contre l’application est à refaire de zéro ou presque : bug graphique, musique qui se coupe et se relance par intermittence...

Ergonomie à revoir (mode offline franchement mal pensé, pas de mode répétition, touche « retour » qui revient sur la page d’accueil plutôt que réellement en arrière...).

Et je ne parle pas du site internet qui reprend tous ces défauts en pire.
